annotations.grafana.app/message: Manage Angie Claude pool status as code

spec.description: Claude account eligibility, cooldown, capacity, sessions, API health, heartbeats, callbacks, and runtime events from the Angie Mac.

spec.expr: 1000 * max(last_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="worker" | attributes_event="heartbeat" | unwrap attributes_last_heartbeat_unixtime [5m]))

spec.description: Latest worker heartbeat from the Angie Mac. Unknown means no heartbeat was observed within five minutes.
spec.title: Latest worker heartbeat

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="account_pool" | attributes_event="snapshot" [15m]))

spec.description: Pool status snapshots observed in the last 15 minutes. A blank value means status is not being emitted.
spec.title: Pool snapshots / 15m

spec.expr: min(min_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="account_pool" | attributes_event="snapshot" | unwrap attributes_eligible_accounts [5m]))

spec.description: Lowest eligible-account count observed over five minutes; deliberately conservative.
spec.title: Minimum eligible accounts

spec.expr: max(max_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="account_pool" | attributes_event="snapshot" | unwrap attributes_at_capacity_accounts [5m]))

spec.description: Highest number of accounts reporting at capacity over five minutes.
spec.title: At-capacity accounts

spec.expr: max by (account) (angie_account_active_sessions and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_active_sessions)))
max by (account) (angie_account_capacity_sessions and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_capacity_sessions)))

clamp_min(max by (account) (angie_account_capacity_sessions and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_capacity_sessions))) - max by (account) (angie_account_active_sessions and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_active_sessions))), 0)
max by (account) (angie_account_usage_five_hour_percent and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_five_hour_percent)))
clamp_min(max by (account) (angie_account_usage_five_hour_reset_unixtime and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_five_hour_reset_unixtime))) - time(), 0)
max by (account) (angie_account_usage_seven_day_percent and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_seven_day_percent)))
clamp_min(max by (account) (angie_account_usage_seven_day_reset_unixtime and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_seven_day_reset_unixtime))) - time(), 0)
max by (account) (angie_account_cooldown_remaining_seconds and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_cooldown_remaining_seconds)))
max by (account) (angie_account_eligible and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_eligible)))
max by (account) (angie_account_disabled and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_disabled)))
clamp_min(time() - max by (account) (angie_account_usage_updated_unixtime and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_updated_unixtime))), 0)

spec.description: One row per configured Claude account. The 5h and 7d columns come from Anthropic's unified rate-limit windows; pool cooldown is Angie's current scheduling hold. Missing usage means the usage monitor has not produced a sample for that account.
spec.title: Per-account Claude capacity — current state

spec.expr: max by (account) (angie_account_usage_five_hour_percent and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_five_hour_percent)))

spec.description: Anthropic five-hour usage percentage for each Claude account. The 95% line is Angie's default usage-hold threshold.
spec.title: 5-hour usage by account

spec.expr: max by (account) (angie_account_usage_seven_day_percent and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_usage_seven_day_percent)))

spec.description: Anthropic seven-day usage percentage for each Claude account. This is independent of the rolling five-hour window.
spec.title: 7-day usage by account

spec.expr: clamp_min(max by (account) (angie_account_capacity_sessions and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_capacity_sessions))) - max by (account) (angie_account_active_sessions and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_active_sessions))), 0)

spec.description: Configured per-account concurrency minus active sessions. An account can still be ineligible because of a usage hold even when this value is above zero.
spec.title: Available session slots by account

spec.expr: max by (account) (angie_account_cooldown_remaining_seconds and on (account, instance) topk by (account) (1, timestamp(angie_account_cooldown_remaining_seconds)))

spec.description: Seconds until Angie will schedule the account again. The table above shows the 5h and 7d reset windows alongside this effective pool hold.
spec.title: Pool cooldown remaining by account

options.content: **Read the table first.** `5h used` is the rolling session window and `7d used` is the weekly window. `Available` is concurrency headroom; `Eligible` is the scheduling answer after disabled, cooldown, and concurrency checks. Usage at or above **95%** normally creates a pool hold until the relevant reset.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" | attributes_event="started" [$__range]))

spec.description: Claude pool sessions started in the selected range.
spec.title: Sessions started

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" | attributes_event="completed" [$__range]))

spec.description: Claude pool sessions completed successfully in the selected range.
spec.title: Sessions completed

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" | attributes_event="failed" [$__range]))

spec.description: Claude pool sessions that emitted a failed runtime event.
spec.title: Sessions failed

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="account_pool" | attributes_event="rotated" [$__range]))

spec.description: Account rotations in the selected range.
spec.title: Pool rotations

spec.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" | attributes_event="completed" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" | attributes_event=~"completed|failed" [$__range]))

spec.description: Completed divided by completed plus failed session runtime events. In-flight sessions are excluded.
spec.title: Completed-session ratio

spec.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.api_request" | attributes_status_class="2xx" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.api_request" [$__range]))

spec.description: 2xx Angie pool API requests divided by all observed pool API requests.
spec.title: Pool API success ratio

spec.expr: sum by (attributes_event, attributes_outcome) (count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" [5m]))

spec.description: Session lifecycle events in rolling five-minute windows.
spec.title: Session lifecycle

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="session" | attributes_event="completed" | unwrap attributes_duration_ms [15m])

spec.description: P95 duration of sessions completed in each rolling 15-minute window.
spec.title: Completed-session p95 duration

spec.expr: sum by (attributes_area, attributes_status_class) (count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.api_request" [5m]))

spec.description: Session creation, status polling, and other pool API requests by status class.
spec.title: Pool API requests by area and status

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.api_request" | unwrap attributes_duration_ms [5m])

spec.description: P95 Angie pool API latency in rolling five-minute windows.
spec.title: Pool API p95 latency

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="worker" | attributes_event="heartbeat" [5m]))

spec.description: Worker heartbeats in each rolling five-minute window.
spec.title: Worker heartbeats

spec.expr: sum by (attributes_event, attributes_outcome) (count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="process" [5m]))

spec.description: Claude process starts and exits.
spec.title: Process lifecycle

spec.expr: sum by (attributes_outcome, attributes_reason) (count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="callback" | attributes_event="delivery" [5m]))

spec.description: Callbacks sent from the Angie Mac to SOMA.
spec.title: Callback delivery outcomes

spec.expr: sum by (attributes_outcome, attributes_reason) (count_over_time({service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | body="angie.runtime_event" | attributes_area="account_pool" | attributes_event="rotated" [5m]))

spec.description: Claude account rotation activity.
spec.title: Account rotations

spec.expr: {service_name="angie_runtime"} | json | severity=~"WARN|ERROR"

spec.description: Warnings and errors emitted by the Angie Mac pool runtime.
spec.title: Recent pool warnings and errors
SOMA Angie — Claude Pool Status
